facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications' Baldna platform offers sign-in with the Sudapass digital ID, and its login page opens and signs in accounts via the digital ID.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications describes Baldna as the national unified platform for data exchange and government transactions, live with 4 government-to-government services.
The Baldna home page counts 48+ government institutions and 141+ digital services on the platform.
The Baldna home page reports 265,785+ completed transactions, of which 148 are government-to-government.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

SDN.note: Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Login by national number is not a register keyed on it.
Nothing on the ID register, biometrics or certification.
